sentences.text: Your records contain 12 source reports dated from 1995-08-13 to 2021-11-07.

Your records list Diabetes, Hypertriglyceridemia, Metabolic syndrome X, Hypertension, Diabetic retinopathy associated with type II diabetes mellitus, Nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus, Neuropathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus, Chronic kidney disease stage 1, and Diabetic renal disease.
Your records also list viral sinusitis in the past.
For creatinine (a kidney test), your latest result was 2.3 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, and over the last 3 reports it went from 1.7 to 2.2 and then 2.3 mg/dL.
For eGFR (how well the kidneys filter blood), your latest result was 32.8 mL/min/1.73m2 on 2021-11-07, and over the last 3 reports it went from 43.5 to 34.5 and then 32.8 mL/min/1.73m2.
For LDL cholesterol (often called 'bad' cholesterol), your latest result was 140.7 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, and over the last 3 reports it went from 120 to 122.1 and then 140.7 mg/dL.
For total cholesterol, your latest result was 227.6 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, and over the last 3 reports it went from 208.8 to 209 and then 227.6 mg/dL.
For blood sugar (glucose), your latest result was 112.3 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, and over the last 3 reports it went from 104.8 to 107.4 and then 112.3 mg/dL.
For triglycerides (a type of blood fat), your latest result was 157.5 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, and over the last 3 reports it went from 171.1 to 178.9 and then 157.5 mg/dL.
The other test results did not raise an alert.
Your latest blood pressure reading was 132/86 on 2021-11-07.
You take lisinopril, Hydrochlorothiazide, and insulin human isophane 70 UNT/ML / Regular Insulin Human 30 UNT/ML Injectable Suspension [Humulin].

sections.title: Points to discuss with your doctor

sentences.text: You can talk with your doctor about your kidney health test results like creatinine and eGFR.
You may also want to discuss your blood sugar and cholesterol levels.
